verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an official MCP server (RudderStack MCP) that works with MCP-compatible clients like Claude, Codex, Cursor, and VS Code/Copilot, enabling agents to investigate delivery errors, write/test transformations, review tracking plans, and query docs via natural language. This is first-party documentation with a dedicated docs page and probe confirmation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of the MCP server in production use.
